role: XCTest suite for DailyLoopAnalysis (Holistic Daily Report loop verdict): workoutIntensity α1/%max-HR fusion, ln(RMSSD) geometric baseline with 3-night minimum, self/later-night/unreliable exclusion, ±0.5 SD SWC band, the six loopStates with the TSB/ACWR guard and advice-gate wording, verdict/tone/paragraph copy, and BaselineTracker.widenedLnSD parity.
state: mem:LanguageManager language (pinned to English per test via pinEnglishLanguage, restored in teardown block)
mem:DailyLoopAnalysisTests.schedule (SleepSchedule 22:00 for 8 h; each fixture night is its own night key)
toplevel: Fixtures: overnight sessions anchored at 1_700_000_000 with a real HRVAnalysisResult (rmssd read via analysisResult.timeDomain); workouts at 1_700_030_000 with optional samples/TRIMP/TrainingContext.

units.does: Per-test async setUp: calls super then pinEnglishLanguage() so asserted English copy matches regardless of host language.
units.entry: XCTest per-test setUp (async)

units.does: Class setUp: saves the process-global NSTimeZone.default into the class's OSAllocatedUnfairLock then sets NSTimeZone.default to TestTimeZone.utc for every test in the class.
units.entry: XCTest class-level setUp, run once before the first test in the class

units.does: Class tearDown: restores NSTimeZone.default from the saved value (when one was captured) and clears the lock.
units.entry: XCTest class-level tearDown, run once after the last test in the class

branches.cond: a saved time zone exists in the lock
branches.effect: true: NSTimeZone.default restored to it; false: default left as-is (UTC from setUp)
